summary:
Successfully implemented KAFKA-20444 part 5: Align TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API.

The implementation adds support for handling GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND and STALE_MEMBER_EPOCH errors in the TxnOffsetCommit API by treating them as abortable errors (CommitFailedException) rather than fatal errors. This aligns with how UNKNOWN_MEMBER_ID and ILLEGAL_GENERATION errors are handled, matching the behavior of the OffsetCommit API.

Changes made:
- Modified TransactionManager.java TxnOffsetCommitHandler.handleResponse() to include GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND and STALE_MEMBER_EPOCH in the consumer group metadata mismatch error handling (lines 1942-1948)

Test results:
- testGroupMetadataMismatchErrorInTxnOffsetCommit with GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND: PASSED
- testGroupMetadataMismatchErrorInTxnOffsetCommit with STALE_MEMBER_EPOCH: PASSED
- All 195+ TransactionManagerTest tests: PASSED

This change enables proper error handling for TxnOffsetCommit API v6+ which introduced these new error codes for group metadata mismatch scenarios.
